11 September 2026
Results of Secondary Placing and Directed Buyback of, in aggregate, approximately 133 million shares in Harbour Energy plc ("Harbour" or the "Company")

Further to the announcement on 10 September 2026, BASF Handels- und Exportgesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung (the "Seller") announces that it has sold approximately 133 million ordinary shares in Harbour by way of a placing and off-market purchase as set out in further detail below.

The Seller has sold 80,000,000 ordinary shares (the "Placing Shares") in the Company at a price of 266 pence per Placing Share (the "Placing Price") via a placing to institutional investors (the "Placing"). Morgan Stanley Europe SE ("Morgan Stanley") acted as sole bookrunner in connection with the Placing.

The proceeds of the Placing are payable in cash on usual settlement terms, and closing of the Placing is expected to occur on a T+2 basis on 15 September 2026. The Company will not receive any proceeds from the Placing.

Harbour has separately agreed to make an off-market purchase of 53,000,000 ordinary shares in the capital of Harbour (the "Off-market Purchase") from the Seller at a purchase price per ordinary share equal to the Placing Price. The Off-market Purchase has been agreed and will close in accordance with the terms of the directed buyback contract entered into by Harbour and the Seller in June 2026, and as approved by the shareholders of Harbour at the annual general meeting held on 7 May 2026, subject to completion of the Placing.

Following closing of the Placing and the Off-market Purchase, the Seller's voting rights in Harbour will be approximately 16% of the Company's total voting rights1. The Seller's remaining ordinary shares in Harbour will be subject to a lock-up of 60 days from closing of the Placing, subject to certain exceptions including (a) that the lock-up will only apply for a period of 30 days for any sales executed pursuant to an existing on-market trading plan that is independently managed by a broker on behalf of the Seller2, and (b) an exception for any sale of ordinary shares to Letterone Holdings S.A. or its affiliates ("Letterone") under the Business Combination Agreement dated 21 December 2023 between (amongst others) the Seller, Letterone and Harbour relating to Harbour's acquisition of substantially all of Wintershall Dea's upstream assets.
1. Assuming shares purchased in the Off-market Purchase are cancelled.
2 The on-market trading plan has been suspended from today for the lock-up period.
